title: Tuli Tuipulotu completely snubbed in top pass rusher rankings

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Tuli Tuipulotu completely snubbed in top pass rusher rankings
sources.description: Tuli Tuipulotu was 4th in TFLs and 6th in sacks last season, but he was not voted amongst the league’s top 19 EDGEs.
